title: CodeIgniter uncaught-exception page disclosed
description: The response is the CodeIgniter exception template: the "An uncaught Exception was encountered" heading with a Filename and Line Number block. The page prints the absolute path of the application and the frame that raised the error.
remediation: Set the environment to production so the framework renders its generic error view, and log the details server-side instead.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the framework template; it does not prove that the path it prints is readable from outside.

observation.body:
An uncaught Exception was encountered

Type: RuntimeException

Message: Order not found

Filename: /var/www/app/controllers/Orders.php

Line Number: 42

An uncaught Exception was encountered

Filename: /srv/site/system/core/Common.php

Line Number: 573

Handling exceptions

An uncaught exception should be logged and rendered as a generic page.
